outcome: Readmission for obstetric or gynecologic complications
cohort: The study included all women undergoing planned cesarean delivery at a tertiary university-affiliated medical center between 2012 and 2023.
finding: Cefazolin was significantly more effective than clindamycin plus gentamicin in preventing the need for inpatient antibiotic treatment and readmission for obstetric or gynecologic complications after planned cesarean delivery.
